name: Fiddlehead fern
summary: A forest green from wet ground near the rocks. VnExpress says it wilts fast, so it is cooked as soon as it is picked: stir-fried, boiled, or as a salad. The ethnic desk names nộm rau dớn.
origin: Around the lake. VnExpress, 2 December 2014. Vietnam Tourism's ethnic desk, 3 November 2024.
howToEat: Cook it the day it is picked. Stir-fry, boil, or make nộm, which is the 2014 list. The ethnic desk names the salad.

VnExpress also says people like it because it is easy to find and is used as a remedy. A dose was not printed. Do not treat that line as a prescription. A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The house table. The ethnic desk showed nộm rau dớn as Tay food of the lake at the 2024 festival in Lang Son.
seoDescription: Rau dớn, stir-fried, boiled, or as a salad, cooked the day it is picked. A price is Check on arrival.
